prompt.freeze_policy: prompt.txt is the canonical artifact (UTF-8, no trailing newline). After gallery publication the prompt text is immutable; corrections require a new case id.

qwen_plan.gpu: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX 24 GB (gfx1100, native Windows ROCm)

gpt_plan.size_note: Pixel- and aspect-matched to the Qwen canvas. Verified against the official gpt-image-2 size rules on 2026-11-01 (custom WIDTHxHEIGHT allowed: 16-px multiples, ratio <= 3:1, 655,360-8,294,400 px, max edge 3840) — every case canvas satisfies them. Contributors may override; overrides are recorded.

verification.rules: Model attribution is never inferred from visual similarity. COMMUNITY_SUBMITTED -> REVIEWED_COMPARISON only after maintainer review of run evidence per METHODOLOGY.md.

notes: Embeds a Midjourney-style '--ar 9:16' parameter and the artist signature string 'BubbleBrain'; both kept verbatim — every model receives the same literal text.
